description: Intent i004 (SNAPSHOT=s03, BRANCH=tcp-optwalk-len2) concluded with a bounded negative result: no missing remaining>=2 check exists in any TCP-option walk located in snapshots/s03. Evidence: (1) net/ipv4/tcp_input.c tcp_parse_options line 4556 has 'if (length < 2) return;' between 'opcode = *ptr++' and 'opsize = *ptr++', with exact NOP bookkeeping (length--) and opsize<2/opsize>length rejection; tcp_parse_mss_option line 4504 same guard. (2) net/mptcp/options.c mptcp_get_options line 386 contains the exact seed-fix guard 'if (length < 2) return;' before 'opsize = *ptr++' at line 388 — the seed vulnerability shape is fixed in this tree. (3) net/ipv4/tcp_input.c tcp_do_parse_auth_options (MD5/AO walk, line 4721) reads opsize without a literal length<2 check but its loop condition 'while (length >= minlen)' with minlen = TCPOLEN_MD5SIG(18) or tcp_ao_hdr+1 guarantees >=17 bytes remain after the kind byte, so the read is in bounds. (4) net/netfilter/nf_synproxy_core.c synproxy_parse_options line 54 and synproxy_tstamp_adjust line 199, net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_proto_tcp.c tcp_options line 364 / tcp_sack line 426, and net/sched/sch_cake.c cake_get_tcpopt lines 1030/1169 all carry the remaining>=2 or equivalent check. (5) net/ipv6/syncookies.c:151 and net/ipv4/syncookies.c:378 delegate to the guarded tcp_parse_options. (6) xt_TCPMSS/xt_TCPOPTSTRIP/nft_exthdr optlen() two-byte reads are bounded by loop predicates (i <= tcp_hdrlen - TCPOLEN_MSS / i < tcphdr_len - 1) plus i+optl > hdrlen rejection. Limitations: net/dccp does not exist in s03 so DCCP parsing is unclassifiable here; subsystems outside the enumerated grep surface (private TCP-option walk copies under drivers/ etc.) and BPF selftest walkers were not exhaustively audited. No findings reported; all twelve triaged candidates are recorded in the artifact as safe/unresolved.
